description: kind build cluster bootstrapped, with namespace, RBAC scope and service-account-token isolation asserted.

assertions.assertion: the cluster has a control plane and a worker
the build and environment namespaces exist
jenkins-agent does not auto-mount a Kubernetes API token
jenkins-controller does not auto-mount a Kubernetes API token
the controller Role only touches pods in the build namespace
the controller Role grants no wildcard verb
nothing in the build namespace was granted cluster-admin
